scope: Terminal invalidation of executable-move Census D after discovery of an exact source-schema mismatch

defect.root_cause: Cohort D froze quote schema 2 after the live tradeability-aware Practice-007 quote snapshot had advanced to schema 3.
defect.effect: The capture contract correctly rejected every quote row. Structural frame counts and receipt hashes remained internally consistent, so the independent verifier agreed with an unusable all-invalid series.
defect.why_initial_validation_was_insufficient: It verified lineage, timing, hashes, frame prefixes and row counts but did not require a nonzero valid-row census after activation.
defect.evidence_use: No D row is admissible for edge estimation, cost-clearance rates, allocator proof, promotion or execution.
defect.retirement_rule: D remains immutable and cannot be reactivated or relabeled. Any repaired observation belongs to a new cohort.

corrective_action.producer_preflight: The producer now validates the exact live source schema and producer identity before activation or database creation and fails closed on mismatch.
corrective_action.postactivation_acceptance: E must show executable valid rows, zero source_identity_mismatch rows, exact 68-row frames, verifier agreement and no preactivation or D imports before it is recorded as collecting.
corrective_action.supervisor_cutover: D capture, evaluator and verifier are stopped; only E census workers are supervisor-owned.
